ms.report:
AdaLink Affiliate Network MVP

URL: ( https://app-preview.adalink.io/ ) 

Notes:
1) Before testing, make sure to set your wallet to the preview testnet.
2) You can sign up as an SPO or as an Affiliate per wallet. Please use different wallets to test different types of users. To sign up as an SPO, you need a preview testnet pool ticker ID.
3) SPOs can create campaigns. You must have Test Ada in your Wallet to Create a Campaign.
4) Affiliates no longer need to send offers. To simplify the process, the dApp will only display the active campaigns available to them in the “Incentive Programs” tab. Affiliates simply need to select the pool and click on “Generate affiliate link” to create the partnership. Once the unique link is created, they can share it with their audience.
5) When people click on the affiliate links, they are prompted to delegate to the partner's pool.

Thank you so much for testing and reviewing!
